mission: BERI is a public charity that removes operational barriers for people working on existential risk and AI safety. Through university collaborations and fiscally sponsored projects it handles finance, HR, grant administration and compliance so researchers can focus on research. It describes itself as an operational hub for the existential-risk ecosystem.

key_work.title: University collaborations and fiscal sponsorship
key_work.plain_summary: BERI's core service: operations support for university research groups and independent projects working on existential risk and AI safety.

key_work.title: BERI blog and impact reports
key_work.plain_summary: Updates on the groups BERI supports and its programme spending.

funding_note: $33M+ deployed in program spending since 2017; 150+ groups and projects supported (BERI homepage).

warnings.text: Reducing existential risk requires a thriving ecosystem, and administrative overhead slows important research down.
Neglected but important projects in the existential-risk field can stall without someone handling their operations.

recommendations.text: Provide shared operations (finance, HR, compliance, grants) so researchers can focus on mission-critical work.
Support neglected projects and solve shared challenges across the field.
